questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:08 to 00:12, the board is fully visible and clearly carries three pens arranged in a horizontal row.
The leftmost pen points downwards with its writing tip visible, while the middle and right pens have their caps at the bottom, indicating a difference in orientation or state (capped vs uncapped).
The leftmost pen appears darker and lacks the black cap seen on the other two pens, which have clear barrels and black caps.
The leftmost pen shows a bare writing tip (or refill end) at the bottom, whereas the other two pens have black caps on their bottom ends.
The board moves continuously and smoothly from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their relative positions on the board as it slides.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is uncapped (showing a bare tip) while the other two pens are capped, violating the condition that all pens must be identical and fully capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
